detail: The case expects the URL path to become '/'. The test asserts this and sets the caption 'After click: <url>', but neither post-click keyframe (05 heading highlight, 06 grid highlight) shows that caption. The recording has no address bar, so the destination URL is visible only before the click ('Opened http://localhost:29080/item/99') and the frames prove the catalog page only through its content. Set the caption once the page has settled, or put the URL in the highlight label, so a frame shows the post-click URL.

The case's first expected result is that the path becomes '/'. The test calls demo.caption(`After click: ${page.url()}`), but frames 05-07 on the catalog show no caption, so the URL after the click never appears. The only URL caption is 'Opened http://localhost:29080/item/99', from before the click. The catalog heading and grid are shown, but the URL change the case checks is not.

The frames show the footer's 'Shop all' text with no visible 'Shop all products', which is correct. But no caption gives the requested URL '/' or the accessible name 'Shop all products' the test looked up. The highlight label is drawn after the keyframe is taken, so the input that makes this case distinct never appears in the frames (lesson L2).

The frames show the footer with the 'Shop all' text, but no caption gives the page URL '/' or the measured count of 0 links named exactly 'Shop all'. The count appears only in the absent overlay label, which is drawn after the keyframe is taken (lesson L2).
